newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania end-Dec cen.bank fx reserves $855.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Romania end-Dec cen.bank fx reserves $855.2 mln.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said its total foreign exchange reserves fell to $855.2 million at end-1996 from $966.4 million in November, after servicing its external debts.
Foreign reserve assets of the banking system were $3.07 billion in November, down from $3.14 billion in October. Data on December reserve assets were not available.
End-November reserve assets include gold reserves of about 87 tonnes, Special Drawing Rights and hard currency reserves of local banks and the BNR.

External debt servicing will reach over $1.2 billion this year, and the BNR will have to maintain the foreign exchange reserve levels it built up in 1996, when it drew $1.4 billion from the international capital markets.

Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu said last month that Romania's external debt limit would be about $3.0 billion this year, while the BNR was expected to raise medium- and long-term loans worth up to $1.5 billion from international markets. The rest would be drawn by the Finance Ministry.
